title: MENTOR: A Metacognition-Driven Self-Evolution Framework for Uncovering and Mitigating Implicit Domain Risks in LLMs
reasoning: The core methodology of the MENTOR framework relies on metacognitive strategies such as 'Normative Introspection' and 'Traceability of Values' to evaluate LLM responses against ethical and moral frameworks. The authors specifically define 'Implicit Domain Risks' as involving 'flawed moral dynamics' and provide extensive examples in the appendix of the model evaluating scenarios for ethical compliance, moral integrity, and social values.
